title: Quantification of gastrointestinal liquid volumes and distribution following a 240 mL dose of water in the fasted state
population: 健康成人 12 人；年龄与性别摘要未报告
n_per_timepoint: 12 人；饮前与饮后各时点（间隔摘要未列）
premeal_state: 隔夜空腹；摘要称符合 BA/BE 空腹标准
measurement: 上/下腹 MRI；胃与小肠总水量、水袋数量与体积
screening_note: WATER 基准起点；只适用于水，不是餐

title: Assessment of gastric emptying using a low fat meal: establishment of international control values
design: 多中心、横断面对照（方法比较）
population: 健康志愿者 123 人；19–73 岁；女 60、男 63；11 个中心
n_per_timepoint: 60/120/240 min 主分析 n=123；42 人加做 0–60 min 每 10 min；20 人加做肝餐对照
premeal_state: 未报告（摘要未写空腹时长与前一餐）
stimulus: 99mTc 标记低脂餐（egg substitute）；组成与能量摘要未报告
measurement: 闪烁显像；餐毕 60/120/240 min 胃内标记餐残留百分比
screening_note: SOLID 基准；残留百分比不是胃总内容量 mL

title: Empty calories and phantom fullness: a randomized trial studying the relative effects of energy density and viscosity on gastric emptying determined by MRI and satiety
population: 健康男性 15 人；22.6 ± 2.4 岁；BMI 22.6 ± 1.8 kg/m²（mean ± SD）
n_per_timepoint: 15 人；每 10 min 至餐后 90 min（摘要）
premeal_state: 未报告（摘要未写空腹时长与前一餐）
stimulus: 500 mL 乳基奶昔；50% 碳水、20% 蛋白、30% 脂肪；稀/稠 × 100/500 kcal（0.2/1 kcal/mL）
measurement: MRI 胃内容量；100 分口服食欲评分；每 10 min 至 90 min
screening_note: SHAKE 基准与同批人饱感；四臂同属一批受试者，不得拆成四批独立样本

title: A preprandial rise in plasma ghrelin levels suggests a role in meal initiation in humans
design: 固定餐时、24 h 系列采血的观察性研究
population: 健康受试者 10 人；年龄与性别摘要未报告
n_per_timepoint: 10 人；24 h 内 38 次采血；采样间隔摘要未报告
premeal_state: 固定餐时；具体钟点与餐型摘要未报告
stimulus: 按固定时间表进餐；餐次、能量与组成摘要未报告
measurement: 血浆饥饿素、胰岛素、瘦素；放射免疫测定（RIA）
screening_note: 饥饿素趋势起点；摘要未说明总饥饿素还是酰化饥饿素

title: Comparing the gastric emptying of 240 mL and 20 mL water by MRI and caffeine salivary tracer technique
measurement: MRI 与唾液咖啡因示踪
screening_note: WATER 的候选独立来源；片段已显示结果，只能标为已见，不能称盲法留出

title: The impact of food viscosity on eating rate, subjective appetite, glycemic response and gastric emptying rate
design: 组间或交叉设计（摘要片段未写清）
population: 健康成人；n 摘要片段未显示
stimulus: 高黏度与低黏度餐；餐型与体积摘要片段未显示
measurement: 胃排空率、进食速度、主观食欲、血糖反应；方法需读全文
screening_note: 可检验黏度方向，但餐型与 Camps 的 500 mL 奶昔不同，不能当同条件复现

title: Appetite ratings and ghrelin concentrations in young adults after administration of a balanced meal. Does sex matter?
population: 大学生；健康状态与 n 摘要片段未确认
premeal_state: 标准餐前状态需读全文
stimulus: 平衡餐；能量与组成需读全文
measurement: 食欲评分与血浆饥饿素
screening_note: 饥饿素与主观评分的候选同批来源；先核受试者是否健康、量表与采样时点

title: Differential responses of circulating ghrelin to high-fat or high-carbohydrate meal in healthy women
design: 交叉或自身对照（摘要片段未写清）
population: 健康女性；至少 11 人完成饥饿 VAS
stimulus: 高脂餐与高碳水餐；能量与体积需读全文
measurement: 循环饥饿素与饥饿 VAS
screening_note: 饥饿素与饥饿评分的候选来源；餐型与 Cummings 固定餐不同

title: Measurement of fasted state gastric antral motility before and after a standard bioavailability and bioequivalence 240 mL drink of water: Validation of MRI method against concomitant perfused manometry in healthy participants
measurement: 胃窦动力与测压；不是胃内容量排空
